why: KV-AHUB4 10-19 (LEAD2-KV, tree K.STA.AHUB): the g2 landed hub (KV-AHUB3) failed the clock rule at gate l1 because ONE core root ck_c owned the core, the reciprocal leaf and the pin flops of BOTH side faces (x 0 and x 734): 11,690 flops over 730 x 536 um, soft spread 686.8..1029.7 TT (374.1 TT / 331.4 FF). g3 splits the face IO into its own regions: w = W-face ap0/ap1 pin flops (u_apw), am0/am1 face drivers (u_amw) and the fr export relay (u_rw); e = E-face ap2/ap3 pin flops (u_ape) and am2/am3 face drivers (u_ame); c = io (hs pins, hf) / core / relays / reciprocal leaf; z0..z3 one Z tree each. Every w/e <-> c and c <-> z bus is an lp.py landing (+3 edges). Schedule 'reference' (core <-> Z loop): the reference is the flat g3 with ZW_RLY = ZR_RLY = 3 (Z round trip), AP_RLY 3 (ap landing), AM_RLY 3 (am landing) and FR_RLY 3 (fr landing); the landed form carries Z_LAND 6 / AP_LAND 3 / FR_LAND 3 so the core's input ages (AP_OFS + 3) and u_io's export lead (WF_RLY + 3) match. Die/compiler deltas: results/arch/kv_ahub4_1019/README.md.

bench.why_expr: before the first regular pass (cyc 2040) starts are issued on every edge while the FLAT reference core's regional reset is still low after the port reset rose (rst_f && !u_flat.u_core.rn[0]); the last one reaches the core on its first released edge + 1, so a landed core whose reset run is one stage long (MUT 4) misses every start and runs no pass while the reference runs one (outputs diverge); later passes every 2000 edges exercise the Z trees and the reciprocal leaf
